content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) pass. I only changed `site/css/styles.css`, with three fixes:

1. **Hero image overflow on phone:** `.img-fluid` had `max-width: 150%`, so the image spilled out of its column and widened the page. I set it back to `100%`.
2. **Desktop nav stacked vertically:** at 992px and up, `.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav` had `flex-direction: column`, which made the navbar tall and pushed everything down. I set it back to `row`.
3. **Active nav link colour:** `--bs-navbar-active-color` in `.navbar-dark` was `#000000`, so the "Home" link was black on the dark bar. I set it back to `#fff`.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing against the approved screenshots. Nothing is committed.

2. **Desktop nav stacked vertically:** at 992px and up, `.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav` had `flex-direction: column`, which made the navbar tall and pushed everything down. I set it back to `row`.
